text:
Anna Patel: Quick heads-up — Integrator Showcase at DataInfra Summit is confirmed for May 18. Need to lock speakers, runbook, demo VM access, and swag/booth logistics. Who can own the run-of-show?
Mike Rivera: I can own run-of-show + speaker coordination. Have we confirmed slot length?
Anna Patel: Slot is 25 mins (15 demo + 8 Q&A + 2 buffer). Need 1 primary speaker from our side and 1 systems integrator speaker.
Sarah Chen: For the demo, we should pre-warm KV cache and enable a persistent session to avoid first-token spike. Will need credentials to the partner staging environment by May 5.
Priya Kumar: I'll handle swag ordering. How many attendee handouts vs partner co-branded items?
Tom Reynolds: Ops asks — booth network will be flaky. Recommend offline demo fallback (recorded video + local VM). I'll bring a small NVMe rig for the local fallback.
Mike Rivera: Speaker ask list: slide deck (10 slides max), demo checklist, short bio + headshot, mobility requirements. Deadline: May 8. I'll DM SI leads today.
Anna Patel: Can we add a brief CI pipeline note for the SI so they don't accidentally run expensive jobs on demo cluster? One-liner in the runbook.
Sarah Chen: Good call. I'll add a warning and a `demo-safe` env var. Also include the model version id and quantization profile we expect: `rw-model-v3-quant8`.
Priya Kumar: Swag plan: 300 stickers, 200 one-pagers, 50 co-branded notebooks, 30 partner polos. Budget approved but need vendor lead time ~12 business days. Ordering deadline May 3.
Mike Rivera: Run-of-show draft (quick):
```
14:00 — Intro (2m)
14:02 — Partner keynote (5m)
14:07 — Live demo part 1 (7m)
14:14 — Live demo part 2 (8m)
14:22 — Q&A (6m)
14:28 — Close (2m)
```
Anna Patel: Ops-bot, can you remind the team 48h before to test AV and network?
ops-bot: Reminder set for 1767400000 (48h before the event). :white_check_mark:
Tom Reynolds: AV checklist: HDMI adapter, 2x mics (lapel + handheld), dongles, local docker image for demo, power strip. Also request venue has ethernet at booth.
Priya Kumar: Shipping: prefer sending swag directly to partner HQ for co-branding then to venue. Partner shipping window: May 10-12 only. Can we route?
Mike Rivera: Yes route via partner HQ, Priya please share partner address and contact. I'll add to the logistics doc.
Sarah Chen: We need test tokens and a low-traffic routing policy on the hosted API to avoid throttles. I'll request elevated quota for the demo account.
Anna Patel: Outstanding owners: Mike (run-of-show + speakers), Sarah (demo infra + tokens), Priya (swag + shipping), Tom (AV + fallback). Can we confirm by end of day tomorrow? :pray:
Priya Kumar: Confirmed.
Tom Reynolds: Confirmed.
Mike Rivera: Confirmed, will post speaker list + one-paragraph abstracts by EOD May 2.
Sarah Chen: Will request quota and send staging creds by May 5.
Anna Patel: Adding final note — contingency script for live failover: if live demo >15s stall, jump to pre-recorded video and continue Q&A. I'll draft the one-liner and add to the runbook.
Mike Rivera: Awesome. I'll create the public runbook doc and share link here when ready. :thumbsup:
Anna Patel: Thanks all — small but high-impact event. We'll sync again Mon morning 10am PT.
Mike Rivera: Monday 10am PT works.
Tom Reynolds: +1
ops-bot: Channel topic updated: "DataInfra Summit integrator showcase — May 18 — runbook in progress"
